text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Managing to cope with the blazing sunlight,
we were able to make smooth progress with Still in Love's training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Terrifyingly smooth sailing.
Her growth shows no signs of stopping.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
“...Let's get on the bus quickly.
Your face is looking quite—”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My vision is warping... Is it because I couldn't
get a decent sleep during the training camp either?
A terrible dizziness hits, and I can barely stand...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Please hold onto me.
I will guide you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "Would you mind if I took the seat next to you on the other side? I'd like to let my Trainer sit down."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Suit yourself.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Thank goodness.
They're sleeping...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...That person.
What happened to them?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
A pale face.
It's almost as if...—no.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Well, about that.
She hasn't seemed to be feeling very well lately.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I'm worried...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What's wrong, Alv?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...
...Thank you for taking care of us during the training camp.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to your guidance, Air Groove-san...
I was able to take another step forward.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
In the upcoming Queen Elizabeth II Cup...
no matter who my opponent is, I will win.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I see. From my perspective as well, your growth has been remarkable.
It will surely lead to good results.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: So, what's your point?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
There's something weighing on your mind, isn't there?
Speak it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
At last year's training camp...
when I collapsed.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
You scolded me with all your heart.
You held me tight... with all your heart.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"You were genuinely worried about me.
...I thought that must be what love is. But..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"It seems you haven't been feeling well lately.
I'm worried about you..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —She was smiling.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: She was... smiling. Looking so happy...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes, that is fine.
Please, rest peacefully."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: The next time I opened my eyes—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"I'll give you... so much mooore—
pleasure."
